action.description: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.
action.description_ko: 소유자가 특정 시점에 수행하는 동작: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
excludes: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
includes: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.

anatomical_connection.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
anatomical_connection.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

composition.description: Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.
composition.description_ko: 프레임 안의 요소 배치와 공간 관계: 촬영 범위·플랫폼 안전 영역을 구별; 각 역할을 실제로 표현할 때만 다중 연결
excludes: 촬영 범위·플랫폼 안전 영역을 구별; 각 역할을 실제로 표현할 때만 다중 연결
includes: Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.

contact_point.description: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.
contact_point.description_ko: 연결된 소유자·신체 부위·물건의 접촉 관계: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
excludes: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
includes: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.

hand_pose.description: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.
hand_pose.description_ko: 소유 손의 정적 형태와 연결: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
excludes: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
includes: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.

light_shape.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
light_shape.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

light_type.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
light_type.description_ko: 광원의 종류와 발생 방식: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
excludes: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
A named day phase or lighting look alone does not identify a source type or emission mechanism.
includes: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

lighting.description: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.
lighting.description_ko: 소유자·배치·광질이 연결된 조명 구성: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
excludes: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
A named lighting look alone, without positively declared source, placement and receiving-surface relations, does not establish a complete illumination setup.
includes: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.

object_structure.description: Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
object_structure.description_ko: 선언된 물리적 물체·설비 자체의 비해부학적 형상, 경계가 있는 부품과 구조적 연결. 장면에서 맡는 용도·프레임 배치·현재 사용 상태와 구별하며, 몸·의복 특화 구조의 소유 범위를 보존한다.
excludes: Anatomical form, pose or continuity, including depicted anatomy whose representation ownership must remain explicit.
Frame arrangement, camera viewpoint, relative prop placement or image acuity alone.
Current open/closed, use, damage or readiness state without a separately evidenced structural feature.
Material identity or repeated surface microstructure alone; abstract two-dimensional graphic-path geometry alone.

A garment-specific construction fact already fully owned by garment_detail does not receive a duplicate generic role for that same fact. Simultaneous roles require separately evidenced properties or distinct owned components.
An optional garment member/profile cannot supply unconditional garment ownership or garment type to a generic parent.
includes: A declared case hinge and separately bounded disc recess; phone halves joined at their hinge.
A named strap assembly with a bar and incoming/returning strap path; a generic attached textile panel with its own bounded edge.
An identified fixture part and its structural joint; no claim of hidden manufacture or performance.

prop_placement.description: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.
prop_placement.description_ko: 소품의 방향·배치·주체와의 공간 관계: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
excludes: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
includes: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.

relational_action.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
relational_action.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

shot_scale.description: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.
shot_scale.description_ko: 대상 대비 촬영 범위의 규모: 포함해야 할 부위의 목적은 subject_framing; 렌즈·거리를 범위만으로 확정하지 않음
excludes: 포함해야 할 부위의 목적은 subject_framing; 렌즈·거리를 범위만으로 확정하지 않음
includes: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.

subject_count.description: Explicit number and grouping of declared visible or required participants.
subject_count.description_ko: 주체 수: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit number and grouping of declared visible or required participants.

subject_framing.description: Inclusion, crop and visibility of named subjects or body regions, with explicit owner and participant count.
subject_framing.description_ko: 지정 주체와 필요한 부위의 프레임 포함 범위: body_framing·partner_framing은 소유자·범위로 통합 검토; shot_scale과 목적 구별
excludes: body_framing·partner_framing은 소유자·범위로 통합 검토; shot_scale과 목적 구별

content.application_contract: Use only the independently declared existing image, participating hands with their actual owners, and actual exchange endpoints explicitly selected by the caller. The caller must state the actual exchange type and all its required endpoints or exchanged subject matter; this source does not supply a transferred object, a new person or an exact person count. Retain the independently declared ownership, distinctness or self-owned part relationships without guessing them. Select that actual exchange AND a macro composition showing only its participating hands, preserving the hands-only coverage of the participants rather than deleting necessary exchange meaning. Exchange, macro scale and coverage remain effects. This proposal reads hands-only as participant coverage; root must explicitly resolve that scope before application if hands-only instead excludes every non-hand item in the complete frame. Do not apply until both coverage scope and actual exchange configuration are explicit; do not invent fingers, hand pose, payload or a completed transfer.

They do not identify object transfer, greeting/information exchange, two people, exact hand count, shared versus different hand owners, payload, completion or whether only excludes non-hand objects from the entire image versus just non-hand participant regions. Keep action/actual-actor/relation.action.exchange E with concrete typed activity and all actual receivers. Add contact/prop/count/transfer/other effects only if that chosen literal truly entails them; never replace performed exchange E by currently-exchanging P.
